scripts.compact: compact compile src/same-holder.compact src/managed/same-holder && node ./scripts/align-runtime-version.mjs && node ./scripts/strip-managed-sourcemaps.mjs
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && rm -rf coverage && rm -rf reports && rm -rf src/managed
scripts.build: npm run compact && rm -rf dist && tsc -b tsconfig.build.json --force && mkdir -p dist && cp -Rf ./src/managed ./dist/ && cp ./src/same-holder.compact ./dist
scripts.all: npm run compact && npm run build && npm run test:ci
